retake.retakeFee: $10 for each DMV retest; the online KnowToDrive exam charges $6.75 each time

gdl.nightCurfew: Drivers under 18 may not drive 10 p.m.-5 a.m. unless driving to or from a scheduled event
gdl.passengerLimits: For the first 6 months, no passengers under 18 except immediate family

requiredDocuments: Proof of identity (certified birth certificate or valid U.S. passport)
Two documents proving Nevada residential address
Under 18: DMV-301 Certification of Attendance signed by a school official
process.realIdNotes: Nevada issues both standard and REAL ID-compliant cards. A REAL ID requires one proof of identity, proof of the SSN, and two proofs of Nevada residential address. A $5.00 surcharge applies to a REAL ID card.
process.permitFee: $22.25 instruction permit plus $25 initial testing fee (under age 65)
process.licenseFee: $41.25 original Class C license plus $25 initial testing fee (under age 65)
process.visionStandard: 20/40 in at least one eye, with or without corrective lenses

facts.pointSuspensionThreshold: 12 points in 12 months results in a 6-month suspension
facts.moveOverRule: Move over or slow down for stopped emergency, tow, and highway maintenance vehicles displaying flashing lights
facts.schoolZoneSpeed: 15 or 25 mph as posted; generally effective on school days from 30 minutes before school begins until 30 minutes after school ends, unless otherwise posted

references.label: Nevada DMV testing
references.citation: Nevada DMV Knowledge and Skills Tests
